subject: U5: CLI / install / backfill — repoRoot resolution + optional --workspace name flag
description:
Resolve workspaces via lib/workspace-registry.repoRoot at the CLI/install entry points and stop reading the pointer file. Independent files from U2/U4 — no overlap.

Changes:
1. packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js:498-511 (registerWorkspace), called ~:1259 — resolve repoRoot(cwd); POST {path: repoRoot, workspace: <optional name>}. Add an optional `--workspace <name>` CLI flag to set the group name (plumb it through to registerWorkspace).
2. bin/install.js:33,44 — WORKSPACE = repoRoot(process.cwd()) (fallback to cwd only for locating the settings file); keep dashboardUrl using ?workspace=<repoPath>.
3. bin/backfill-merged.js:96 — remove the `readFileSync(BASE/'workspace')` pointer fallback; require --workspace or read repos via lib/workspace-registry (loadRegistry/allRepos).

Match existing CLI style. Do NOT touch daemon.js (U2), mcp-graph.js/hooks (U4), or routes (U3). If a test suite covers the CLI (test/cli-init.test.js), run it against the feature branch and confirm green.
